opening.argument: The video promotes a OneCoin-linked card as a profitable financial product, asserting that users and recommenders earn money and urging viewers to participate. It presents OneCoin as having both a cryptocurrency and a banking system, while stating that "many people come to me to buy card," which supports that the message solicits purchases rather than merely discussing the company. The compensation model is tied to recruitment: "The more customers we are bringing, the more commissions we are going to receive." Alongside the card imagery, these claims encourage buying the card and bringing in customers for commissions, yet provide no substantiation for the asserted financial benefits.
